title: CCS Install
description: Build your cold email system in order. Start with the first lesson.

children.title: Start Here: Build Your AI Cold Email System
children.description: What You Will Build, What The AI Does And How To Get Grok Bot Ready.

children.title: Add The CCS Instructions To Grok Bot
children.description: Save the CCS methods and check that your Bot can read them.

children.title: Tell The AI About Your Agency
children.description: Give the AI the facts it needs before it makes recommendations.

children.title: Research Buyers And Build Your Offer
children.description: Choose buyers who can value your work and put the scope and price in writing.

children.title: Connect Your Tools And Set Your Budget
children.description: Check the accounts, sending inboxes and permissions before a campaign is prepared.

children.title: Prepare Your Website And Sales Materials
children.description: Give prospects a clear explanation and prepare for the calls you want to book.

children.title: Build And Check Your First Lead List
children.description: Find suitable people, check the companies and keep uncertain rows out of the campaign.

children.title: Write, Approve And Load Your Emails
children.description: Turn the offer into two emails, check every field and keep the campaign paused.

children.title: Test Replies And Meeting Booking
children.description: Check how the AI handles fit, drafts, calendars and mistakes before real replies arrive.

children.title: Review And Launch Your Campaign With CCS
children.description: Bring the whole setup to review and separate launch approval from practice results.

children.title: Complete Your Handover
children.description: Save what was installed, what was demonstrated and what you do next week.

title: CCS Resources
description: Open the detailed lesson or template you need, then return to your Install step.

children.title: Go-To-Market Strategy
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Understand Why Some Clients Can Pay More
children.description: See how your client's customer value changes what your work could be worth. Use this before choosing a market or a price.

children.title: Choose Clients Who Can Afford Your Service
children.description: Finish with one buyer group, clear exclusions and a list of facts to check before you offer a price.

children.title: Research Buyers And Find A Reason To Reach Them
children.description: Build a research brief your AI can use to choose an angle and write relevant emails.

children.title: Create An Offer Worth Paying For
children.description: Turn your service into a clear result, a defined body of work and terms a buyer can understand.

children.title: Define The Opportunity Your Client Will Pay For
children.description: Agree what counts before you charge for an opportunity or promise a delivery target.

children.title: Choose Your Fees And Payment Terms
children.description: Choose a payment structure that pays for the work, leaves delivery margin and gives the buyer clear protection.

children.title: Explain Your Agency's Value In Plain Words
children.description: Write one clear explanation of who you help, what changes and what work you handle.

children.title: Use Genuine Proof And Collect Better Case Studies
children.description: Give the AI only the results and examples you are allowed to use.

children.title: Funnel
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Build A Website That Explains The Offer
children.description: Finish with a clear draft page and a booking button that leads to the correct next step.

children.title: Write And Record A Clear VSL
children.description: Create a script that explains the buyer's problem, your approach and the next step.

children.title: Set Up And Check Your Booking Page
children.description: Give suitable prospects one correct place to choose a time, with the right host and calendar.

children.title: Prepare The Correct Payment Request
children.description: Match the payment request to the accepted offer so the buyer sees the correct amount and schedule.

children.title: Put The Scope And Payment Rules In Writing
children.description: Prepare a complete commercial brief for the agreement without relying on missing Notion attachments.

children.title: Client Acquisition
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Set Up Sending Inboxes And Connections
children.description: Know which accounts the system needs and check access before you ask the AI to operate them.

children.title: Build A Lead List You Can Check And Reuse
children.description: Create a repeatable search and keep the raw export so every row can be explained.

children.title: Collect Website Evidence Without Guessing
children.description: Give the AI evidence about each company and keep missing pages out of automatic approval.

children.title: Check AI Qualification Against Your Own Labels
children.description: Make sure the AI applies your rules before you let it classify the whole list.

children.title: Map Fields And Check Every Email Variable
children.description: Prevent blank greetings, wrong names and unsupported personalised claims.

children.title: Write Short Emails That Make The Offer Clear
children.description: Write one good email at a time, then lock the approved words before loading.

children.title: Check Email Health Without Guessing
children.description: Spot a list, inbox or sending problem and choose a clear next action.

children.title: Use LinkedIn By Hand After The Email Setup
children.description: Add a manual channel using a checked list and messages prepared before you open LinkedIn.

children.title: Use A Warm Caller For Interested Leads
children.description: Help an interested person take the next step when email alone has not produced a booking.

children.title: Understand The Words Used In This System
children.description: Use this page when a lesson names something unfamiliar.

children.title: Inbox And Pipeline Management
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Follow Up Without Mixing Different Sales Stages
children.description: Keep cold bumps, interested replies, sales proposals and later reconnects separate.

children.title: Sales
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Run The Sale From First Call To Agreement
children.description: Use two purposeful conversations for a larger engagement instead of trying to explain and agree everything at once.

children.title: Find The Commercial Gap On The First Call
children.description: Understand the buyer's business and find the sales stage your service can help create.

children.title: Keep The Deal Moving Between Calls
children.description: Give the buyer one useful next action so call two starts with real feedback.

children.title: Build A Proposal From The Actual Call
children.description: Produce a short, complete scope the buyer can review and forward to other decision-makers.

children.title: Prepare Sales Materials For The Right Moment
children.description: Answer common buyer questions with material they can read and share.

children.title: Answer The Real Concern Behind An Objection
children.description: Practise clear answers using the actual scope and evidence rather than memorised pressure lines.

children.title: Show The Work And Value Behind The Fee
children.description: Make the implementation and ongoing work visible without inventing bonus values.

children.title: Scaling And Hiring
children.description: Lessons, examples and files for this part of your system.

children.title: Collect The Information Needed To Deliver
children.description: Turn a signed client's information into the five files the system actually uses.

children.title: Train An Operator To Run The Agreed Tasks
children.description: Define the remaining human work and test whether someone can do it before handing it over.

children.title: Make The Work Repeatable And Review The Bottleneck
children.description: Write down the tasks another person or AI must repeat, then improve the real constraint each week.

children.title: Follow One Agency From First Setup To Handover
children.description: Read the same completed files through research, offer, leads, campaign, reply practice and reporting.

children.title: Templates, Instructions And Completed Examples
children.description: Get the working file for the step you are completing.

children.title: Private Preview: What Has Been Checked
children.description: Separate student material, local tests and real account checks.

title: CCS Training
description: Use these lessons after CCS has demonstrated your installed system and completed your handover.

children.title: Start Here: Run Your Installed System
children.description: Learn the daily and weekly jobs after CCS has demonstrated your actual cold-email system.

children.title: Handle Daily Replies And Bookings
children.description: Check interested people, answer their questions and make sure the right meetings reach your calendar.

children.title: Refill Your Lead List Before It Runs Out
children.description: Prepare fresh suitable contacts using the same checked recipe, without contacting the same person again.

children.title: Write And Check One New Email Version
children.description: Test a useful change without losing the approved version or changing several things at once.

children.title: Prepare Another Paused Campaign
children.description: Check new leads and locked emails in the right workspace before anything can send.

children.title: Review Results And Email Health Each Week
children.description: Know what happened, what needs attention and the one job to do next.

children.title: Fix Problems And Get Help
children.description: Identify the failed step, keep the evidence and avoid making a duplicate live action.

children.title: Repeat The Process For A Cold Email Client
children.description: Use the checked system for a client without mixing their buyers, proof or permissions with your agency's.

children.description: Weekly CCS coaching calls with Sean and Matt.
